deals: Galaxy A17 5G On Us with Unlimited Plus Monthly when you put another $85 into the account at a T-Mobile store. Plus $10 device connection charge.
Unlimited Promo: 2 lines for $75/mo (1 line $55). Add a new line and get 50% off the 2nd line. Limited time.
notes: No financing: phones are paid in full at purchase. No annual contract, no credit check, $0 early termination fee.
Paid monthly, in advance. AutoPay takes $5 off per account starting the month after enrolling, so the first month is charged without it. AutoPay needs a debit card or bank account.
Activation or plan change: $0 online or in the T-Mobile Prepaid app, $10 per line in store.
Bring your own phone: it must be unlocked and compatible. Check the IMEI (dial *#06#). eSIM phones can activate in the T-Mobile Prepaid app.
Talk and text are unlimited for calls and texts between 2 people. Heavy users (over 50GB a month) may see lower speeds during congestion.
5-year price guarantee on talk, text and data. Taxes, fees and add-ons are extra and can change.
Typical 5G speeds: 144 to 561 Mbps down, 6 to 34 Mbps up.
